name: android-wear-compose-m3
description: Expert guidance for working with Wear OS Compose Material3. Use this skill when creating, updating or migrating Wear OS projects. This includes the androidx.wear.compose.material3, androidx.wear.compose.foundation and androidx.wear.compose.navigation3 libraries. Also working with core components such as AppScaffold, ScreenScaffold and TransformingLazyColumn. Migration from earlier versions such as Material 2.5 and Horologist.
